title: Logistic regression on movie reviews
audience: Beginners in machine learning who can read a little Python

questions.q: How many reviews are in the test set?
How many features (columns) does the bag-of-words matrix of the training reviews have?
Of the 3 negative reviews of the test set, how many did the model classify correctly?
What weight does the model give to the word "great"?
The review "worst film year really bad" is negative, but the model gave it a probability of 0.608 of being positive. What explains it?
options: "worst" is not in the vocabulary, so it adds nothing, and words such as "really" and "year" push towards positive
The model had too few negative reviews to learn from
That review was in the training set
